reason: The Exp background conserved charge should be reconstructed from native GE15 accepted background endpoints, not from PCHIP-interpolated 64/32 nodes. This mirrors the CLASS law K_Q=I0/a^3 and prevents interpolation error from being interpreted as charge non-conservation.

frozen_method.native_rows: use the deduplicated accepted-step rows of the first frozen k mode over the GE19 window
frozen_method.Exp_coordinate: solve KQ/(4*K2*Z0)=Z exp(Z^2) on positive branch

claim_boundary: This amendment changes only how the same exact conserved Exp background is reconstructed numerically. It does not change the theory, first-order direction, matter model, H1/H3 equations or any science threshold.
